original_rows.notes: Font_FTLibrary mapping (visualization-design.md section 2): FreeType is loaded at run time with dlopen (font::freetype_ffi binds only the entry points the Font package calls; the record layouts follow the FreeType 2 public headers); a missing library or a failed FT_Init_FreeType leaves the library invalid, as natively; the library is released on drop. Exercised by every sv_ftfont native probe request.

Font_FTFont mapping: the FreeType face (owned raw handle, released by Release or drop), the Unicode-subset fallback faces, glyph identities and outlines (FT_Outline_Decompose callbacks), bitmaps and metrics, with the state behind the handle's shared lock; FindAndInit uses Font_FontMgr and the embedded fallback font. Metrics, bitmaps (pixel hash), advances with kerning, glyph identities, outlines and bounding boxes of system and embedded fonts are compared bit for bit by the sv_ftfont native probe; the GoogleTest suite Font_FTFont_Test is translated. Forward declaration.
